title: JGraphT reconstructs three edge-disjoint routes in the original graph
summary: Both algorithms recovered the expected three vertex sequences and weights. Both returned a 3→7 edge object absent from the input graph. The single-route control used only the original edges.

change.description: Both disjoint-path algorithms share the corrected reconstruction of routes after successive shortest-path searches.

notes: Each deployment checks the JDK fingerprint, ordered artifact digests, caller classes and original class providers. The same compiled caller runs both sides in fresh JVMs.
